title: Northwind names Ilse Verhoeven as chief financial officer
text:
Northwind Robotics has appointed Ilse Verhoeven as chief financial officer. She will start on 1 December.

Verhoeven joins from Delta Parcel Group, where she was finance director for northern Europe. She replaces Tomas Riedel, who is leaving Northwind at the end of November after five years.

The appointment comes a week after Northwind announced a Series B funding round. Chief executive Marit de Wolff said Verhoeven had been hired to prepare the company for its next stage of growth, including expansion outside Europe.
